explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/230 with the negative answer from Kahane's ultraflat polynomials. There is no c > 0 such that every Σ_{k≤n} a_k z^k with |a_k| = 1 and n ≥ 2 has max_{|z|=1} |P| ≥ (1+c)√n. The circle maximum is a real iSup of a continuous function on a compact set, so it is genuine. Formal proof linked.
